subject.description: The tech.tokimeki.forum.thread or tech.tokimeki.forum.message being hidden. The cid records the version that was judged.

main.description: A moderator's decision to hide a thread or message in this server. Written by the moderator (owner, admin or mod) into their OWN repo within the space: a repo only ever carries its holder's own statements. The record's existence is the hide; delete it to unhide. rkey is derived from the subject URI ('h' + base32lower(sha256(uri))[0:26]) so one moderator holds at most one hide per subject. The service index honours hides from accounts that hold a moderator role at the time of indexing.
